title: SFLOW configuration causes swss docker to exit in Broadcom TD3-X2 platform in 202205 release.
author: haris-CLS
body:
#### Description:
'config sflow enable' command causes swss docker to exit after sflow feature is enabled by using 'config feature state sflow enabled' command.  Reason is as part of the sflow configuration, Broadcom tries to open the file /proc/bcm/knet_cb/psample/rate and it got failed since the file doesn't exists. psample-cb.o object file is responsible for loading '/proc/bcm/knet-cb/psample/rate' file. And this object file is not included  due to BUILD_PSAMPLE=1 flag is removed in the recent commit.
(https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/commit/8bc8b96c4a69cdb4357131b713bd6a2f916d7833). 

Before this commit, it was working fine. @saiarcot895 I couldn't find this issue is reported in this forum.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Load 202205 community SONiC release build into broadcom TD3-X2 chipset device


2. Enable sflow feature by using 'config feature state sflow enabled ' command.


3. Ensure sflow docker is instantiated successfully before executing sflow rleated config commands by using 'docker ps' command.

4. And also check 'psample' module is installed in kernel by using 'lsmod | grep psample' command.

5. Enable sflow globally by using 'config sflow enable'. It invokes '_brcm_sai_port_proc_samplerate_set()' API in which  '/proc/bcm/knet-cb/psample/rate' file is opened for write operation. But it throws 'file not found' error and the swss docker is being stopped.

#### Describe the results you received:
'config sflow enable' command is failed and swss docker is stopped. ''/proc/bcm/knet-cb/' library is not loaded into kernel, since psample-cb.o object file is included only if BUILD_PSAMPLE flag is equal to 1. Hence we couldn't test SFLOW feature in the community SONIC 202205 release build. The same issue is seen in the latest master branch's image as well.

#### Describe the results you expected:
sflow configs should be added in its config_db and expects SFLOW feature works fine.

comments.author: saiarcot895
comments.body:
@adyeung 

Looks like in [`platform/broadcom/saibcm-modules/sdklt/linux/knetcb/ngknetcb_main.c` line 435](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/platform/broadcom/saibcm-modules/sdklt/linux/knetcb/ngknetcb_main.c#L435), psample initialization is done only when Broadcom's own psample kernel module support is enabled, even if the kernel's psample module is used as a dependency. Can this be changed to check for kernel support for psample (or maybe just unconditionally require it)?

comments.author: adyeung
comments.body:
@saiarcot895 BRCM's copy of psample was removed earlier to use the kernel's psample module, I believe the dependency check can be changed/removed
@michaelli10 to help take a look

comments.author: haris-CLS
michaelli10
comments.body:
Hi @hari-selvam
Can you try adding an or condition for CONFIG_PSAMPLE to check for kernel support for psample?

comments.author: haris-CLS
comments.body:
@michaelli10 : Thanks for your response. Replaced '#ifdef PSAMPLE_SUPPORT' check with '#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_PSAMPLE)' check in this file and its working as expected. 
Shall I proceed to raise a pull request for the same?

comments.author: michaelli10
comments.body: Sounds good.  Yes please raise the PR.

comments.author: haris-CLS
comments.body:
@saiarcot895 @adyeung @michaelli10 : When I retested the fix with my fresh build, I have found the compilation itself is failed.  The same fix[Replaced '#ifdef PSAMPLE_SUPPORT' check with '#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_PSAMPLE) ] has to be added in "platform/broadcom/saibcm-modules/systems/linux/kernel/modules/knet-cb/knet-cb.c" file in addition to ngknetcb_main.c file. And also "ifeq ($(BUILD_PSAMPLE),1)" conditional check should be removed to fix 'psample-cb.o' dependency issue for ngknetcb_main.c file(psample_* APIs are defined in psample-cb.c file) compilation as follows.
```
_**+++ b/platform/broadcom/saibcm-modules/sdklt/linux/knetcb/Kbuild
@@ -17,10 +17,7 @@
 # A copy of the GNU General Public License version 2 (GPLv2) can
 # be found in the LICENSES folder.$
 #
-ifeq ($(BUILD_PSAMPLE),1)
-PSAMPLE_CFLAGS=-DPSAMPLE_SUPPORT
 PSAMPLE_CB_OBJS=psample-cb.o
-endif

 obj-m := linux_ngknetcb.o**_
```

To include psample-cb.o dependency I had tried to replace "ifeq ($(BUILD_PSAMPLE),1)" conditional stmt by "ifeq ($(CONFIG_PSAMPLE),m)" in Kbuild file, but t didnt help. So removed the "ifeq ($(BUILD_PSAMPLE),1)" conditional stmt itself as mentioned above to include psample-cb.o dependency as in knet-cb.c file.   

Apologies for my earlier mistake and late findings.

Could you please review and provide me your valuable comments?

comments.author: michaelli10
comments.body:
Can you try this in the Kbuild file?  Removing the conditional check for building psample-cb.o will fail if CONFIG_PSAMPLE is not enabled.


ifneq ($(CONFIG_PSAMPLE),)
PSAMPLE_CB_OBJS=psample-cb.o
endif

linkedPullRequests.title: [sflow]: Unblocked psample_*() function calls  related to BRCM specific procfs for sflow feature's working in ESW platforms
linkedPullRequests.author: haris-CLS
linkedPullRequests.body:
Fixed sflow feature code breakage in BRCM ESW platform.

*Replaced BRCM SDK's psample support flag(PSAMPLE_SUPPORT) with linux kernel psample module support config flag(CONFIG_PSAMPLE) in saibcm-modules. 
*Replaced BUILD_PSAMPLE conditioanl check with CONFIG_PSAMPLE to build psample callback library(psample-cb.o), only if psample config is enabled in linux kernel. 
*Cleaned up PSAMPLE_SUPPORT related commented code.

Signed-off-by: haris@celestica.com

<!--
     Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines:
     https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md

     ** Make sure all your commits include a signature generated with `git commit -s` **

     If this is a bug fix, make sure your description includes "fixes #xxxx", or
     "closes #xxxx" or "resolves #xxxx"

     Please provide the following information:
-->

#### Why I did it
SFLOW configuration(config sflow enable) causes swss docker to exit in Broadcom Td3-X2 family chipset platform. Reason is as part of the sflow configuration, Broadcom tries to open the file /proc/bcm/knet_cb/psample/rate and it got failed since the file doesn't exists. psample-cb.o object file is responsible for loading '/proc/bcm/knet-cb/psample/rate' file. And this object file is not included due to BUILD_PSAMPLE=1 flag is removed in the recent [commit.](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/commit/8bc8b96c4a69cdb4357131b713bd6a2f916d7833)
#### How I did it
Unblocked psample_*() function calls in BRCM ESW platforms for proper functionality of sflow feature.
*Replaced BRCM SDK's psample support flag(PSAMPLE_SUPPORT) with linux kernel psample module support config flag(CONFIG_PSAMPLE) in saibcm-modules.
*Replaced BUILD_PSAMPLE conditioanl check with CONFIG_PSAMPLE to build psample callback library(psample-cb.o), only if psample config is enabled in linux kernel.
*Cleaned up PSAMPLE_SUPPORT related commented code.
#### How to verify it
1. Check psample module is insmoded by default by using 'lsmod | grep psample' command.  pass
2. Check required procfs such as (debug, map, rate,  size,  stats) are created under /proc/bcm/knet-cb/psample/ folder.  pass
3. Enable sflow feature by using 'config feature state sflow enabled' command. pass
4. Check sflow docker is instantiated by using 'docker ps' command. pass
5. Check sflow config(config sflow enable) doesnt stop swss docker. pass
6. Check COUNTER and FLOW samples are being received at the configured collector interface. pass
7. Change sflow attributes(global and interface specific) and verify the config changes are affecting samples count or not. pass
8. Check sflow functionality after cold reboot. pass

Replaced BRCM SDK psample support flag with kernel psample config flag to unblock the creation of BRCM specific procfs for sflow feature's working in ESW platforms. It fixes [Issue#12810](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/12810)
